en: \[Claude Code on the web] Improved the new-session repository picker when GitHub single sign-on hides organizations: it now says so even with other repositories listed, and links to reconnect GitHub
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 改进新 session 的仓库选择器在 GitHub 单点登录隐藏组织时的表现：即使已列出其他仓库也会说明该情况，并提供重新连接 GitHub 的链接
